about: The secreta of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Accept, we beseech Thee, O Lord, the prayers of Thy people together with the offerings of sacrifice, that what hath begun with the paschal mysteries may, by Thy working, become for us a remedy unto eternity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
